column1: # Stock DreamSeeker 516 (wine, scripts/dreamseeker-pixel-oracle.sh --keep) x stock DreamDaemon 516.1684, world.dme here.
# Driven with xdotool on a private Xvfb (right button down/up, F3/F4 pressed while it is held), read from the world's log
# (the lines below, verbatim apart from the "the " article) and from root-window screenshots for the menu. The map is 224x224
# at 32 px a tile; pixels are 0-based from the viewport's bottom-left. Targets: NB t_B (40,151) a turf with no verb; NR
# (40,87) rock_B over t_B, rock has a verb (poke), the turf none; SB (8,151) vg static over a bare turf; SR (8,87) static
# part A: the flag (show_popup_menus) at the press and at the release of one right click (hold 0.3-0.5 s) at NR. A flag
# change is made while the button is held. sent: what the world logged. menu: whether a verb menu was on screen after the
# release (never while the button was down).
# part B: the rows a menu lists (flag on at both). Only atoms with a verb are listed; with none there is no menu.
# part C: the verb menu closing. The pointer moved over the map while it was open and sent nothing; on closing (Escape, or a
# press elsewhere) stock reported the atom under the pointer at once, as a hover (EXIT of the stale atom, ENTER of the new
# one; params carry right=1 and no button=right when the right button was held at that moment). With vg's rule on, a right
# click on static after that sent DOWN UP CLICK and opened no menu.

column2: menu opened at NR, pointer moved to SB (10,150), Escape
column3: EXIT the t_B icon-x=9;icon-y=24;screen-loc=2:9,3:24 flag=1 | ENTER the obscured icon-x=11;icon-y=23;vis-x=11;vis-y=151;screen-loc=1:11,5:23 flag=1

column3: EXIT the t_B icon-x=9;icon-y=24;screen-loc=2:9,3:24 flag=1 | ENTER the t_E icon-x=11;icon-y=24;right=1;screen-loc=6:11,3:24 flag=1 | (a new menu, rock_E, opened at the release)
